dedupe_keys.name: norwegian railway traffic data 2013 2023 bane nor train movements

description: This dataset holds every scheduled train movement on the Norwegian rail network from 2013 to 2023, with planned and actual arrival and departure times, delays, cancellations and delay cause codes. It has 130,067,333 records for 15,220 train numbers, 598 stations and 32 operating companies, with lookup tables for stations, companies, train types and cancellation codes, and it reports about 5.9% of records as fully cancelled. The Kaggle release states that the data come from Bane NOR, the Norwegian rail infrastructure manager, which originally published them as tab-separated files for 2013-2017 and 2018-2023. Coverage is the national network of Norway. Access: free download from Kaggle (about 12 GB, account needed to download) under the Apache 2.0 licence stated there; the page says Bane NOR published the source as open data. Caveats: this is a third-party repackaging; times are to the minute, relative delay is filled only when a cause is registered, line numbers and train consist are not included, and some station entries are block posts, not stations. It supports delay propagation and reliability analysis, disruption and cascading failure studies on a rail network and calibration of rail simulation models, and complements the Norwegian road data and the UIC RAILISA statistics catalogued here.
name: Norwegian railway traffic data 2013-2023 (Bane NOR train movements)
